job.title: IT Support Engineer II, Ops Tech Solutions (OTS)
job.pay_full: $60,700 – $106,300 a year base salary (Houston), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Operations Technology Solutions (OTS) provides nonstop global IT support to Amazon Operations. As an IT Support Engineer II you support, build, implement and improve technology across sites in a defined geographical area, manage large projects that affect multiple locations with minimal guidance, and get customers working again in a crisis.
duties: Troubleshoot difficult IT problems without standard operating procedures
Plan and coordinate CMs and CM templates
Work with internal teams or vendors to deliver projects, and lead continuous improvement
Audit the quality of work and give constructive feedback
Automate manual tasks and build or improve small tools for the team
Serve as the first point of escalation and help hire, train and develop others
Support customers in multiple buildings in the area and remotely, travelling locally or regionally
Move up to 49 lbs and stand and walk during shifts lasting 12 hours
needs: 4+ years of IT systems or relevant commercial production environment experience
4+ years of Microsoft administration, Linux administration or Cisco IOS (CLI) experience
4+ years troubleshooting in a multi-user high availability environment
4+ years of networking (DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI model, TCP/IP)
4+ years of PC repair, troubleshooting, deployment and liquidation
3+ years of IT client, server and network service delivery
nice: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Red Hat), Microsoft hardware, AWS or other relevant certifications
Experience explaining complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences
Experience managing and prioritising multiple projects
details.benefits: Base salary $60,700 – $106,300 a year (Houston, TX). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Amazon lists healthcare benefits from day 1 (medical, dental, vision, prescription, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement), 401(k) matching, paid time off and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave.
notes: Shifts can last 12 hours and the role involves moving up to 49 lbs
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
